Reconcile Desk

shashank100/openenv-reconcile-desk

Inspect messy government payment files, match supplier aliases, resolve revisions and duplicates, and deliver an exact results CSV.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • terminal data-reconciliation tasks
  • OpenEnv Arena submissions

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Pass or fail

Reward is 1 only for correct supplier order, exact columns, two-decimal values and all totals; a protected verifier never runs the agent's code.

How to run it

1. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download shashank100/openenv-reconcile-desk --repo-type dataset --local-dir openenv-reconcile-desk

Framework documentation: OpenEnv. Needs: Docker image, no network required.

Evidence

Tests include an independent reference solver and empty, incorrect and NaN output controls; no training improvement is claimed.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
